beforeCustomerProduction.issue: Receipt retention and erased note content
beforeCustomerProduction.decisionNeeded: Define retention duration, erasure behavior, compaction and operations monitoring. Do not choose a duration without product/contract decision.
beforeCustomerProduction.implementationConstraint: A deleted annotation-ID tombstone alone cannot identify an old POST, whose annotation ID was server-generated. Retain/reject old operation IDs with request hash and result/tombstone metadata, or enforce an explicit bounded retry protocol; never simply purge receipts and permit an old create again.

beforeCustomerProduction.followup: Consider app.user_id context and user-scoped receipt policy; current application queries bind tenant+user. This is defense in depth, not changed in the approved release.
